results.title: Study results (CONSORT)
results.description: Participant flow and the primary (ANCOVA) and secondary (gain-score) analyses for the adaptive-vs-fixed comparison. Computed over completers (both pre- and post-test).
results.ancovaHint: The pre-registered primary analysis: the group difference in post-test scores, controlling for the pre-test. p < 0.05 indicates a significant adaptive-vs-fixed effect.
results.gainHint: Welch's t-test on gain scores (post − pre), with Cohen's d as the effect size.
results.notEnough: Not enough completers yet for this analysis.

prereg.title: Pre-registration
prereg.description: Lock the study design and hypothesis with a timestamp before analysing data, so the analysis plan is fixed in advance (open-science practice).
prereg.hypothesisPlaceholder: e.g. Teachers in the adaptive group achieve higher post-test scores than the fixed group, controlling for pre-test.
prereg.unlocked: Not locked yet. Save a draft freely; lock once the design is final.
prereg.changedWarn: The study design has changed since it was locked. Re-lock only if the change is intentional.
prereg.lockConfirm: Lock the current design and hypothesis with a timestamp? This records the analysis plan as pre-registered.

documentation.title: AIDEA — The AI-Driven Educators Academy
documentation.tagline: AI as a catalyst for pedagogical transformation.
